title: A currency mod
description: A mod made for me and some freinds, adds a new currence the terry coin(worth 1) and the perry coin(worth 0.01)
body: A mod made for me and some freinds, adds a new currence the terry coin(worth 1) and the perry coin(worth 0.01). you can craft four terry coins with four gold ingots and one perry coin with one gold nugget, there are also two achivments, one for getting a terry coin and one for getting a perry coin.
